name: Accessibility & Inclusive Design
description: Accessibility & Inclusive Design standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-A11Y applies.

rules.title: Support keyboard-only operation
rules.detail: All interactive functionality is reachable and operable by keyboard with a visible focus indicator and logical focus order.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Support keyboard-only operation.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Support keyboard-only operation.

rules.title: Use semantic controls and accessible names
rules.detail: Prefer native semantic elements; custom controls require correct role, name, state and interaction semantics.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Use semantic controls and accessible names.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Use semantic controls and accessible names.

rules.title: Meet contrast and non-color communication requirements
rules.detail: Text, controls and status indicators must meet the project accessibility target and never rely on color alone.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Meet contrast and non-color communication requirements.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Meet contrast and non-color communication requirements.

rules.title: Associate form labels, instructions and errors programmatically
rules.detail: Validation identifies the field, explains the problem and is announced to assistive technology where applicable.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Associate form labels, instructions and errors programmatically.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Associate form labels, instructions and errors programmatically.

rules.title: Manage focus for dynamic UI
rules.detail: Dialogs, route changes and async errors move/restore focus intentionally without trapping users unexpectedly.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Manage focus for dynamic UI.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Manage focus for dynamic UI.

rules.title: Test accessibility with automated and manual checks
rules.detail: Use automated tooling plus keyboard and representative screen-reader/manual review for critical flows.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Test accessibility with automated and manual checks.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Test accessibility with automated and manual checks.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-A11Y applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Accessibility & Inclusive Design to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Accessibility & Inclusive Design is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Accessibility & Inclusive Design failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
